newsitem.title: CANADA: Abacan signs Nigerian oilfield purchase.
newsitem.headline: Abacan signs Nigerian oilfield purchase.

text.p: Abacan Resource Corp said on Tuesday a series of agreements representing the final milestones in bringing its NGO field on production were executed, covering the provision of the remainder of funds required and the purchase of production from the field.

Abacan said its wholly owned subsidiary Liberty Technical Services Ltd, and its Nigerian partner, Amni International Petroleum Development Co Ltd, concluded a US$30 million debt financing from MeesPierson NV and ING NV, both of the Netherlands.

It said the proceeds would be used to meet Abacan's current and future financial commitments associated with the ongoing development of the company's NGO field offshore Nigeria and was slated to be repaid out of net proceeds of production. The NGO field is scheduled to commence production in the fourth quarter of 1996, Abacan said.
It said it also executed an agreement with Total International Ltd in which Total agreed to purchase all of the crude oil and condensate produced from the NGO filed by Liberty and Amni.
The sale price of the crude oil will be based on the world price of crude at the time of lifting and the quality of the crude produced.
